findings.summary: Approved Change Control implemented the exact Pool/Direct/Block Compiler mapping.
Apply terminal state is generation- and operation-bound.
Shared Provider invalidation, polling and response ordering are present.
Dialog dismissal observes the current busy state.
Runtime mutation work is dispatched outside the synchronous command path.
The reviewed target lacked a reproducible path/hash manifest, the fixed 127.0.0.1:9090 selector fixture was unavailable, and the complete acceptance evidence matrix was not yet closed.
The Custom Pool Dialog offered Manual initial nodes by provider only, without applying the draft NodeFilter or clearing a selection excluded by a later filter change.
Frontend probe URL validation accepted localhost and rejected the backend-supported bracketed IPv6 loopback host.
